title: Shift Register with Parallel Load
constraints: Priority on each rising edge: `rst` (q = 0), then `load` (q = din), then `shift`, else hold.
`dir = 0`: shift **left**. q ← {q[6:0], serial_in}. `dir = 1`: shift **right**. q ← {serial_in, q[7:1]}.
`serial_out` is the bit that the next shift would push out: q[7] when `dir = 0`, q[0] when `dir = 1` (combinational from q and dir).
hints: One register and a priority if/else chain.
Concatenation does all the work: `{q[6:0], serial_in}` and `{serial_in, q[7:1]}`.
Chaining `serial_out` into another register's `serial_in` builds longer registers: that's how scan chains and SPI shift registers work.
